title: config-merge
blurb: A deployment config merger drops explicit false and zero overrides. Preserve every value supplied by the environment.
brief:
This service combines safe defaults with environment-specific overrides before boot. Operators noticed that disabling a feature or setting a numeric limit to zero had no effect.

The tests describe the merge contract: nested mappings merge recursively, while every explicitly supplied scalar—including `false`, `0`, and an empty string—must replace the default.

**Your job:** fix the merger without mutating either input mapping.
